scenes.visual_description: A late Victorian gentleman's study at night, cluttered and cozy. Gaslight flickers on dark mahogany furniture, piles of old books, and scientific equipment. A coal fire burns in the grate, casting warm orange glow on two armchairs and a bearskin rug. Thick curtains drawn against the night. Haze of tobacco smoke in the air.

A Victorian study in afternoon light. The room is messy with books and papers. A fire crackles in the hearth. Holmes sits by the fire, laughing, dressed in a tweed suit. Watson sits opposite, listening.

Dusk in a quiet London street, 1888. A charming two-story villa with a garden wall stands back from the road. Street lamps glow yellow against the twilight. A horse-drawn landau carriage waits at the curb. Brick facades and leafy trees visible in the gathering dark.

A Victorian sitting-room, elegantly furnished with pastel feminine decor. Floral wallpaper, plush velvet sofa, and gas lamps lit against the night. A large window stands open to the street. A bell-pull hangs near a sliding panel. Smoke hangs in the air.
A quiet residential London street at night, dimly lit by gas lamps. Shadows stretch across the pavement. Brick row houses line the road. Mist swirls around the lamp posts.
The exterior doorstep of 221B Baker Street at night. The black painted door with brass knocker is visible. The pavement is dimly lit by a nearby streetlamp. Foggy London atmosphere.
A late Victorian study in bright morning light. The breakfast table is set with toast and coffee. The room is messy with books and papers. Dust motes dance in the sunbeams.
A Victorian sitting-room in disarray. Drawers hang open, papers are scattered on the floor, and shelves are dismantled. Sunlight streams through the large window. The room looks ransacked.
The busy street outside 221B Baker Street in daylight. Pedestrians walk by, carriages rattle past. The black door stands closed. London bustling atmosphere.

A late Victorian study in bright morning light. The breakfast table is set with toast and coffee. The room is messy with books and papers. Dust motes dance in the sunbeams falling across a Persian slipper filled with tobacco.

A poky, shabby-genteel London square under a grey sky. Dingy two-storied brick houses surround a small enclosure of weedy grass and faded laurel bushes. A corner shop features three gilt balls and a sign reading 'JABEZ WILSON'. Smoke-laden atmosphere.

A late Victorian gentleman's study at night, cluttered and cozy. Gaslight flickers on dark mahogany furniture. A coal fire burns in the grate, casting warm orange glow on two armchairs. Thick curtains drawn against the night.

A vast, cold stone vault or cellar. Pitch darkness is cut by a single thin beam of a lantern, revealing massive wooden crates and boxes piled high. The floor is lined with large stone flags. The air is damp and earth-smelling.

A Victorian study in the early grey hours of dawn. A siphon of soda water and whisky glasses sit on the table. The gas lamps are dimming as cold morning light begins to bleed through the curtains. The fire has burned down to ash.

A late Victorian study bathed in pale morning light entering through a large window. A coal fire burns in the grate between two comfortable armchairs. The room is cluttered with books, papers, and scientific instruments. A breakfast table sits nearby. Warm mahogany and amber tones with a haze of tobacco smoke.

A messy Victorian study at night, illuminated by the warm glow of gas lamps and a fireplace. A large table is covered in chemical apparatus, test tubes, and bottles. Deep shadows fill the corners. The atmosphere is cozy but scientific, with a thick blue haze of pipe smoke.

A Victorian breakfast room bathed in soft morning light. A table set with crisp white linens, silver cutlery, and china sits in the foreground. Sunlight streams through sash windows, illuminating dust motes. Warm cream walls and mahogany furniture create a domestic atmosphere.

A first-class Victorian train compartment in motion. Plush velvet seats with lace antimacassars face each other. A large window reveals passing English countryside. The rack above is piled with luggage. Piles of newspapers and documents clutter the seats. Natural daylight shifts with the train's movement.

A private sitting room in a country hotel. Faded floral wallpaper and chintz armchairs. A tea table with a silver service sits near a fireplace. A window looks out onto a quiet country street. Soft afternoon light filters through lace curtains.

A damp, wooded glade in the English countryside. Tall beech trees cast dappled shadows over marshy ground. A small reed-girt pool reflects the grey sky. Red pinnacles of a manor house are visible in the distance. Muted greens and browns dominant.

A comfortable Victorian study offering refuge from a violent storm outside. Rain lashes against dark windows while a fire roars in the hearth, casting flickering orange light on books, scientific charts, and two armchairs. The room feels enclosed and warm against the howling gale outside. Tobacco smoke hangs in the air.

A large double-bedded room filled with a dense haze of tobacco smoke. Sunlight streams in, contrasting with the stale remnants of the night. An improvised Eastern divan of pillows sits on the floor. A Gladstone bag rests near the door.

A plain, masculine bedroom with a camp-bed and a small shelf of technical books. A large iron safe sits prominently on a round table next to a saucer of milk. A wooden chair stands against the wall. Austere and functional with a clinical atmosphere.

A dusty, uncarpeted corridor in a disused wing of the house. Paint peels from the walls. A heavy wooden door is barred with a metal bed-frame and padlocked. A slit of light shines from beneath the door. The atmosphere is grim, dirty, and threatening. Dim evening light.
